api_token.description: API token for CubePath Cloud. Can also be set via CUBE_API_TOKEN environment variable.

baremetal_deploy_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for baremetal deployment operations. Defaults to 1800 (30 minutes).

base_url.description: Base URL for the CubePath API. Defaults to https://api.cubepath.com. Can also be set via CUBE_API_URL environment variable.

default_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for API operations. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed API requests. Defaults to 3.

retry_wait_max.description: Maximum wait time in seconds between retries. Defaults to 30.

retry_wait_min.description: Minimum wait time in seconds between retries. Defaults to 1.

vps_create_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for VPS creation operations. Defaults to 600 (10 minutes).

vps_destroy_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for VPS destruction operations. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).
